notes: Web 449 — CLOSE-SHUTS-EVERYTHING (Nov 13, 2026; layers on web 448). Owner's law, restated Nov 13 08:45 CST: "If I close the shift — either the Stop button on the timer or in the dispatch — one closing should close everything; I should not have to close it everywhere else." Web 440 proved the dispatch-to-timer direction; the timer-to-dispatch direction was never built, and two sync holes let a closed day's dispatch face reopen. ROOTS (bench-proven failing-first on web 447 bytes): (1) stopSessionAt booked the session and stood the timer down but never completed the day's dispatch — the End-shift review literally told him to go close it from the Dispatch card; the day's record stood ACTIVE with its snapshot live, one tap from a second close on stale facts. (2) dsp_active is a whole-doc stamp key with no merge: a device still holding a stale snapshot overwrote the close's clearing null on its next flush, and the snapshot then survived the reopen pull — list closed, snapshot open. (3) The dsp_list union arbitrated same-record copies by field count: a stale open copy carrying one extra mid-day field (a top-level photo the close folded into its ticket, an offline note) tied or beat the COMPLETED copy, rolled the cloud back to OPEN, and the closing device became the only surface showing the day closed. FIXES: (a) js/app.js — stopSessionAt now completes the session day's ACTIVE dispatch in the same action (closeDispatchOnStop449): status completed, endedAt = the stop's own end time, verified by read-back before the cloud-doc mirror fires (the fbSave shape); the active snapshot clears with it; 'saved' records, other days' records and already-completed records (their endedAt stands) are never touched; the v419 cross-day burial still returns before any of this; a dispatch-close stop finds its record completed and books/moves nothing twice. The End-shift review now says "Your dispatch closes with this shift — this one close ends the whole day." (shown only for the session day's own dispatch). (b) js/cloudsync.js — in the dsp_list union a COMPLETED copy beats a non-completed copy outright, whichever side holds it (both-completed or neither keeps the ordinary arbitration, so a later edit of a closed record still wins on its facts). (c) js/cloudsync.js — the dsp_active push guard: before a non-null snapshot goes up, the dispatch list decides (local copy first, then the cloud's read fresh); if either holds the record COMPLETED, what pushes is the clearing null; a failed list read fails the push honestly (key stays dirty, retries) instead of overwriting a close blind. (d) js/cloudsync.js — the pull-side snapshot heal: after the per-doc loop, a local snapshot naming a record the just-settled list holds COMPLETED is cleared in place and stamped dirty so the clearing pushes up; a different account's list is never read as evidence; an open day's snapshot is never touched. BENCH: new tools/close-shuts-everything-v449-test.js 44/44 — per entry point: timer Stop completes the dispatch + clears the snapshot + mirrors the doc + books exactly once; dispatch close books nothing twice; a second Stop books nothing; a second device converges closed on its next pull; the exact Nov 11-12 shape replayed (close on the web, phone flushes its stale list AND stale snapshot at pagehide, reopens: cloud list + cloud snapshot stay closed, the phone converges — list completed, snapshot clear, tracker idle, widget/bubble clock frozen at the close, and a Stop after the close books nothing); the fatter-stale-open union probe; the open-day guard. REGRESSION: full 361-suite sweep on pristine 447 vs this tree — zero behavioural deltas (close-echo 25/25, close-not-reaching-phone 29/29, close-shuts-timer-v411 36/36, unsynced-record-loss 38/38, cloudsync-v136 51/51 identical; the only changed lines were version.json manifest-hash era pins in four suites, which the manifest rebuild below restores to their pristine counts); the three 448 nav benches pass on the merged tree (27/27, 39/39, 21/21). PIN MOVES: index.html js/app.js 447 -> 449, js/cloudsync.js 446 -> 449; version.json via tools/build-ota.js (webVersion 449, manifest refreshed). NO NATIVE CHANGE. VERDICT OWED IN HIS HANDS: at tonight's close-out, close from ONE place only — the timer Stop button OR the dispatch close-out, not both — then fully close and reopen the app: the tracker card, widget and bubble must stand idle and stay idle, Dispatch must show the day Closed with no second close offered, and the day must stay closed on the web copy too.
